description: Run MeTube — a yt-dlp web UI — in Docker on the remote, bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:8081 (reached only over the SSH tunnel). Paste a video/playlist URL in the web UI and yt-dlp downloads it on the server into ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4. Inspired by a Docker yt-dlp setup.

steps.description: Install Docker if it isn't already (official get.docker.com script). Skipped if docker is present.
steps.run: curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh && sudo sh /tmp/get-docker.sh && { sudo usermod -aG docker $USER || true; }

steps.description: Start the MeTube container: web UI on 127.0.0.1:8081, downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads, merged to mp4.
steps.run: mkdir -p ~/yt-dlp-downloads; docker rm -f metube 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name metube --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8081:8081 -v ~/yt-dlp-downloads:/downloads -e PUID=$(id -u) -e PGID=$(id -g) -e YTDL_OPTIONS='{"merge_output_format":"mp4"}' ghcr.io/alexta69/metube

steps.description: Wait for MeTube to finish starting.
steps.run: for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8081/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo 'MeTube is still starting — give it a moment, then open it.'

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the MeTube container. Your downloads in ~/yt-dlp-downloads are kept.
